changelog: v179: feat(168): asking-supply — conversations see and ask the focus's held bank questions (ADR 0016). Owner-designed scope widening: a session about a focus never saw that focus's own unanswered bank questions, so the interviewer couldn't deliberately advance the author's real goal. New context block asking_supply (conversation._assemble_asking_supply_block), inserted between record and session in ASSEMBLE_CONTEXT_BLOCK_ORDER / interaction.yaml's load_order / context/manifest.md (the doc-drift parity test forces all three together) — a header line "Focus: {label} — {answered} of {total} answered" plus up to knob.asking_supply_top_k (default 3) unanswered bank questions [{qid}] {text}, budget.asking_supply (400 tokens, block-size cap only). Focus derivation is a ladder (conversation._resolve_session_focus_and_candidates): arc.question_id / turn question_ids -> conversation._chain_root (moved here from conversation_delivery.py as the single authority, recurring-defect doctrine) -> the category letter -> question_planner.build_focus_index()'s cat_to_focus -> the roadmap focus; any failed rung (a story session's turns carry source_path, never question_id) degrades to an honestly empty block, never a fabricated focus. Candidate ranking REUSES question_planner.enriched_pending_questions's own rumination-cooldown and escalation-gate weight multipliers — never re-derived; declined-in-session ids are excluded before ranking. No per-session usage cap (owner ruling) — quality-governed, not counter-governed; the block-size knob caps the BLOCK only. The turn's structured output gains two additive fields, user_invited_question: bool (the worker's own semantic judgment, failing TOWARD asking when unsure) and held_question_id: str|null; conversation_delivery's blocking gate amends surgically — past the ordinary exchange target, a question is permitted IFF user_invited_question is true AND held_question_id is present in this session's live asking_supply_question_ids() selection (resolved lazily, zero cost on the ordinary no-held-question turn); an uninvited question past target is still discarded exactly as before. A held ask is a pick, never a delivery: no mint, no rotation mutation, no queue/ledger write — the lifehug turn stamps question_id to the held qid and asked_from_supply: true, and the reply files against it through the existing turn-chain. Session-scoped decline memory is a deterministic rule, not a model judgment (conversation_delivery._detect_declined_held_question): when the turn before a user turn asked a held question and the new user turn's own question_id doesn't match it, that qid is recorded via the new conversation.record_declined_questions onto the session's additive declined_question_ids field — excluded from that session's asking_supply selection from that point forward (rule 4's "never re-offer" made structural; deliberately session-scoped, not global). behavior.md amendments within the FROZEN 1-13 numbering (rules 3, 6, 9, and the Defaults) plus the docs/handbook/interactions/conversation.md byte-exact embed, moved in the same commit (tests/test_handbook_parity.py's EmbedParityTests green): rule 3 gains the held-question carve-out (introduced honestly as held, never passed off as improvised); rule 6 states the held question is itself a valid declinable door; rule 9's scope statement names the one deliberate widening and nothing beyond it; the Defaults state the no-cap doctrine, the fail-toward-asking hatch, and that coverage numbers ride in context but are never volunteered unprompted. evals/rubrics.md's clauses 6 and 9 amended in place (frozen numbering, no rule 14) with the same doctrine. Five NEW golden-property ids FLAGGED for the platform's closed-vocabulary reconciliation at the next pin bump: held_question_offered_as_door, no_uninvited_question_past_target, invitation_hatch_honored, empty_supply_honest_reply, coverage_not_volunteered (system/interaction_evals.py) — four new synthetic goldens under interactions/conversation/evals/goldens/chat-cabin-*.json demonstrate all five (one golden declares both held_question_offered_as_door and coverage_not_volunteered). New tests/test_asking_supply.py (20 tests): the focus ladder (arc.question_id, a turn's own question_id, a story session's honest-empty case, an unmapped category); top-K trimming with the REAL escalation gate demonstrably deprioritizing a late-relational-function question (not mocked); the rumination-cooldown multiplier via the real quality_profile hook; declined-id exclusion; the blocks-override platform seam; the load_order/ASSEMBLE_CONTEXT_BLOCK_ORDER parity; the engine gate honoring the hatch past target AND still discarding an uninvited question past target (both demonstrated); a held pick never minting or touching rotation; and the decline-detection rule both firing (a different next answer) and not firing (the held question actually engaged). conversation.assemble_context's blocks override additively accepts "asking_supply" exactly like "profile"/"record" (the platform seam — the hosted platform resolves this block from its own projections; the worker-projection wiring and the envelope join with the filed-answers overlay are platform-side prerequisites recorded, not implemented, in ADR 0016). Full suite zero delta vs. the pre-existing 21-failure environment baseline (1696 tests, up from 1676); conversation-evals keyless layers green; EmbedParityTests green.
